summary: The tiny_vec! macro expands its heap arm using unqualified vec!, which fails to resolve in downstream no_std crates without that macro in scope. The fix uses $crate::alloc::vec! to resolve through tinyvec's alloc re-export. The proposed reversal restores that exact unqualified invocation. Blocked: the added tests/no_std_macro.rs contains only the compile-check function expands_to_heap, with no #[test]. Existing runtime macro tests use the std prelude, masking the bug. No qualifying executable regression test was found; compilation failure alone cannot satisfy the confirmation gate.
expected_failure: cannot find macro `vec` in this scope
